source_selection_method.role_assignment_evidence: parent-agent message before acquisition; no prior new-game ID found in configs or docs
source_selection_method.visual_evidence: All18 original BARD clips fully decoded; half-second source contact sheets viewed. Recovery regions inspected at0.1s spacing; source-only per-frame reference work remains pending. SAC original-source bounded windows viewed similarly.
source_selection_method.not_claimed: This is source suitability screening, not every-frame label acceptance or model-output visual acceptance.
source_selection_method.reference_source: Use original source pixels or verified lossless derivatives; lossy previews/contact sheets are navigation evidence only.
source_selection_method.recovery: Observed body/hand occlusion and subsequent visible ball in all selected4s recovery episodes. Exact certain-hidden versus partial/unknown categories and recovery endpoints require full-resolution reference proposals and human acceptance; no recovery performance is claimed.
source_selection_method.pending_category_details: Per-frame eligibility, exact occlusion duration, blur severity and uncertain centers remain for reference preparation; do not manufacture labels from coarse source tags.
source_selection_method.game_identity_evidence: BARD pinned game directory IDs and matching visible team/court/scoreboard; SAC existing verified game source receipt.
source_selection_method.nonoverlap: Six distinct BARD event plays per game with different scoreboard clocks; SAC six disjoint live-play windows away from existing opening-play accepted frames. Entire game role prevents replay/alternate-encode leakage.

limitations: Fresh validation means no prior local project fitting/selection or pixel exposure found before this source selection; it is not a sealed final test.
Retained WASB upstream pretraining game inventory is incomplete; independent-from-all-pretraining status is not claimed.
Event-clip convenience sample is not a full-game benchmark.
Encoded60fps BARD cadence is verified by PTS; original camera cadence or unique images on every frame is not certified.
BARD action metadata is provenance/selection context, not ball-center labels.
Copyrighted footage and generated outputs remain ignored.

SAC.join_rule: Parse first CSV column as presentation seconds, convert to nearest integer1/90000 ticks, sort unique PTS; zero-based sorted index is source_frame. Every selected decoded native PTS was found exactly once. This is the same presentation ordering used by existing source selection.

BARD.join_rule: Zero-based source_frame is full native decode presentation order; pts and time_base read directly from decoded PyAV frame. Individual full clip maps bind acquisition and episode subsets.
